title: Limitless World
description: LimitLess – Remove every limit. Break Minecraft your way. A lightweight Fabric mod that completely disables 9 of Minecraft’s biggest built-in restrictions.
body:
**LimitLess**
Remove every limit. Break Minecraft your way.
LimitLess is a Fabric mod that completely removes the built-in restrictions from 9 core Minecraft mechanics. Turn on any (or all) of the features and watch the game become pure chaos in the most fun way possible.
Whether you want infinite arrows raining forever, a single villager spawning an army of iron golems, or the entire Overworld slowly turning into one giant sculk biome — this mod lets you do it.
All 9 features are fully controllable via custom gamerules and a beautiful in-game menu.

<hr>

**✨ Features**

**_Infinite Arrows (infiniteArrow)_**

Bows shoot infinitely while held — no arrows needed ever again.

**_Infinite Breeding (infiniteBreed)_**

Mobs breed endlessly. One pair becomes an infinite kid generator.

**_Infinite Fluid Flow (infiniteFluidFlow)_**

Lava and water spread without any distance limit and can flood the entire world.

**_Infinite Food (infiniteFood)_**

Eat as much food as you want, even with full hunger and saturation bars.

**_Infinite HP (infiniteHp)_**

Health regeneration never stops and the HP cap is removed — you basically become immortal.

**_Infinite Iron Golems (infiniteIronGolem)_**

Villagers can summon iron golems with no bed requirement and no limit on how many already exist nearby.

**_Infinite Spawners (infiniteSpawner)_**

Spawners ignore all their normal limits and can spawn mobs endlessly.

**_Infinite Spread (infiniteSpread)_**

Sculk catalysts spread forever and can slowly take over the entire world.

**_Infinite XP (infiniteXp)_**

Negative XP system added so you can reach truly unlimited experience levels.

<hr>

**🎮 Controls & Config**

Press M (default key, fully rebindable) to open the LimitLess Config Screen anytime.
Full support for Mod Menu — clean, modern config UI.
All features are off by default and controlled with /gamerule commands so you stay in full control.

<hr>

**⚠️ WARNING — READ THIS**
This mod can (and probably will) ruin your world.
Infinite fluids, infinite sculk spread, endless breeding, and god-mode HP can cause massive lag, performance issues, or make your world literally unplayable.
Use at your own risk. Always back up your world before enabling any features. Best used in creative mode or fresh testing worlds.

<hr>

**Installation**

Install the latest Fabric Loader
Drop the mod .jar into your mods folder
(Highly recommended) Install Mod Menu for the in-game config screen

<hr>
